title: Outstanding Croatian Chicken Skewers
description: A floral and creamy Croatian dish featuring malai and miso-marinate, this recipe is perfect for a dinner party, providing an energizing and delicious meal for your guests. The combination of flavors and textures will leave everyone satisfied and wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, making sure it reaches a safe internal temperature of 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together malai cream, miso paste, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, thyme, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and mix well to coat, covering the bowl with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate the chicken for at least 2 hours or overnight to allow the flavors to meld.
Thread the marinated chicken onto the wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Croatian chicken skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs and a side of your choice.
